description: This source file implements a traversal and rewriting pass for shader expressions involving shader storage buffer objects (SSBOs). It rewrites complex expressions containing SSBO calls into simpler forms suitable for HLSL translation, handling various operator cases including binary, unary, and aggregate function calls.

classes.name: RewriteExpressionsWithShaderStorageBlockTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that rewrites expressions involving shader storage buffer objects (SSBOs) into simpler forms for translation.

methods.name: IsIncrementOrDecrementOperator
methods.description: Checks if the operator is a pre/post increment or decrement.

methods.name: IsCompoundAssignment
methods.description: Checks if the operator is a compound assignment operator.

methods.name: IsReadonlyBinaryOperatorNotInSSBOAccessChain
methods.description: Checks if the binary operator is a read-only operator not in SSBO access chain.

methods.name: HasSSBOAsFunctionArgument
methods.description: Determines if function arguments include SSBOs.

methods.name: RewriteExpressionsWithShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Main function that performs the rewriting pass on the AST.
